//! Declaration shapes used by error strategy conversion.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Leaf { pub message: String, file: String, code: usize }
impl std::error::Error for Leaf {}
/// Doc comments belong to the declaration's edit range.
#[derive(Error)]
pub(crate) struct Parent { kind: Box<Kind>, source: std::boxed::Box<Leaf> }
#[derive(Debug)]
enum Kind { Native(Leaf), Named { source: alloc::boxed::Box<Leaf> }, Empty }
struct Borrowed<'a> { source: &'a Leaf, kind: &'a Kind, message: &'static str }
struct Mutable<'a> { source: &'a mut Leaf, message: &'a mut str, marker: &'a () }
struct Tuple(pub String, #[cfg(unix)] Box<Leaf>, &'static str);
struct Unit;
#[derive()]
struct EmptyDerive;
struct Bounded<'a: 'static> { source: &'a Leaf }
struct Mixed<'a, T> { source: &'a Leaf, value: T }
struct Where<'a> where Leaf: 'a { source: &'a Leaf }
struct Two<'a, 'b> { source: &'a Leaf, kind: &'b Kind }
struct Unsupported<'a> {
    callback: fn() -> String,
    array: [u8; 4],
    tuple: (String, usize),
    projection: <Leaf as Trait>::Assoc,
    source: Generic<Leaf>,
    kind: &'a Generic<'a>,
    unsupported_box: Box<'a>,
    qualified: std::string::String,
    absolute: ::String,
    integer: u128,
    text: &str,
}
#[derive(derive_getters::Getters)]
struct Getters { message: String, source: Leaf }
struct Unicode { /* é */ message: String }
#[doc = "explicit"]
struct Multiline {
    #[cfg(feature = "alternate")]
    pub(in crate) source:
        Box<Leaf>,
    #[other]
    detail: String,
}
enum Variants<'a> { #[doc = "a"] Unit, Tuple(&'a Leaf, bool), Named { source: Leaf } }
